from itertools import combinations

def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
 color=grid[0][0]
 pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=color]
 for (r,c),(R,C) in combinations(pts,2):
  dr=R-r; dc=C-c
  if dr==0 or dc==0 or abs(dr)==abs(dc):
   import math
   n=math.gcd(abs(dr),abs(dc))
   if n>1:
    sr,sc=dr//n,dc//n
    for k in range(1,n):
     if grid[r+k*sr][c+k*sc]==color: out[r+k*sr][c+k*sc]=3
 return out
